question: Do reported net redemptions after public release help choose between the same two managers historical holdings more than fixed fund identity?
financial_hypothesis: Higher previous redemption pressure may leave temporary selling effects which subsequently recover; delayed publication or persistent selling can remove or reverse this association
main_conditional_definition: redemption - subscription + dividend reinvestment, /beginning NAV, clipped at zero; Huaxia reinvestment inclusion is accounting-structure inference
required_definition_sensitivity: raw report redemption - subscription, /beginning NAV, clipped at zero; report both, no winner selection
fixed_opponents: lagged Jiashi share of covered holding value
negative of same Jiashi share; symmetric diagnostic, no ex-post choice
universe: all securities in union of both complete beginning-half holdings; final holdings not required; current missing symbols retained
calendar: SZSE official saved calendar, after max actual report publication, six calendar months later first verified trading day; final calendar/source coverage absent is unknown
ties: equal fractional membership at the boundary, never arbitrary code tie-break
metrics: Spearman rank correlation, not win rate
selected known-slice qfq price change minus same-pool known price change
paired differences vs both fixed identities
per-period results and unknown selection weights
leave-one-period-out paired mean, descriptive not confidence interval
no_score_periods: IC and selection unavailable; not cash or zero returns
unknown_future: preserve formation and predetermined selection weights; no zero fill; known-slice means explicitly conditional
known_limits: later reconstructed qfq, no total-return or personal fee claim
no securities trading-status or terminal-property qualification
possible adjacent horizon overlap; no independent significance claim
no full control for prices, industry, size or existing LEI strategy
two selected surviving funds, not historical fund market population
effect_budget: one fixed descriptive matrix, zero fits and no parameter search; both definitions predeclared necessary semantic check
public_source_gate: 28 original reports complete, full stocks and unit/NAV bridges; source schema qualification only
controls: do not change LEI, definitions, production, trading, or sealed US study
